arm: v0_isla_qtsdfval_qcount_seed{42,43}: reference QT+SDF config trained with interior_n_points_range=[2000,20000] (code_qcount)
instrument: float32 under code_eval, 48 cars, dedup by sample_id, two-seed means; controls = reference checkpoints at the same counts
verdict: Query-count augmentation over [2k, 20k] reduces the request-size dependence by about 40% (pressure penalty at 2k: +38% -> +24%; velocity +59% -> +31%; nu_t +49% -> +31%) and improves the 2k prediction outright (0.0703 vs 0.0753), at a 3.7% accuracy cost at 10k (bar 1 fails). The dependence is not removed: a substantial intrinsic request-size dependence of the interacting decode remains, so query-count consistency is partly architectural.
